answer.says: Ramesh, the samosas in the fridge. Bring one with tea, if it is not too much trouble. The heat has dulled my appetite, but the spirit requires some sustenance before the afternoon's work.
answer.thought: The haze outside is a physical manifestation of the indeterminate state of my file; it obscures the horizon just as the bureaucracy obscures the resolution. I shall finish this paragraph on the dialectic of recognition before the tea arrives.
